messages:
lucy: launching staged rollout v2026.5 -> 10% (ap-south 5%, eu-west 5%). No model schema changes. Heads-up monitors: p95, 5xx, kv-hit.

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] rollout id r-332x started: v2026.5 -> ap-south:5%, eu-west:5% (profile: cost-optimized). Guards: p95<=1.4x, 5xx<=0.3%, kv-miss<=+10%.

rachel: noticing p95 embed tail in ap-south 2.0x baseline on a small sample. No 5xx yet.

lucy: can we isolate ap-south only and drop it back to stable while eu-west stays? prefer softpause rather than full rollback.

ops-lead: auto-policies: will auto-pin if p95 > 1.6x OR 5xx uplift > 0.4%. Current ap-south p95=2.0x -> trigger. Suggest softpause + pin ap-south to v2026.4 and then run infra warming and a micro-probe.

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] pausing r-332x for ap-south. To pin: `rbctl pin r-332x ap-south v2026.4 --reason "embed p95 regression"`

infra-oncall: starting +2 warm instances in ap-south and enabling kv-prefetch for embed route. ETA ~5m.

carlos: dropping quick traces: req/9912, req/9913 — kv-miss spike coincident with tail. snippet:
```
kv_miss_rate: 14% -> 37%
latency_tail @ 2026-03-24T09:12:02Z
```

rachel: pin applied by deploy-bot (rbctl ok). Kicking off eval comparing v2026.5 vs v2026.4 on failure corpus.

infra-oncall: warmup done and kv-prefetch ON. Observability: kv-hit climbing back to baseline.

lucy: proposal: run 0.5% micro-probe in ap-south for 8m with guard p95<=1.25x, 5xx<=0.2%. If pass, move to 2% for 10m then rejoin main 10% plan. Thoughts?

ops-lead: agree with micro-probe staircase. Add enforcement: if probe p95 > 1.15x for two consecutive 1m windows -> immediate pin.

(deploy-bot) launching probe: r-332x ap-south -> 0.5% for 8m (guards set).

(deploy-bot) probe finished: PASS. p95 ~1.08x, 5xx flat.

rachel: eval shows output parity within tolerances on test prompts. Good to ramp.

lucy: incrementing ap-south to 2% now, will watch 10m then rejoin 10% global plan. updating release notes and changelog to note the softpause and probe.

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] ap-south ramp -> 2% (complete). eu-west remains at 5%.

ops-lead: action items: (1) add micro-probe step to canary playbook, (2) make kv-prefetch part of default canary flags for embed-heavy routes, (3) follow-up postmortem. Leaving thread open until items tracked.

lucy: thanks everyone. tagging @oncall for visibility :rotating_light:

rachel: metrics stable, closing once action items are in tracker.
